description: Right-click (and Shift+F10 / ContextMenu key) menu with keyboard navigation and shortcut bindings

attributes.name: data-open
attributes.description: Reflected when context menu is visible. Uses data-open because the host is not a native dialog/details — open would be semantically misleading.

structure.description: Right-click target area. Made focusable (tabindex="0") when it is not already, and given aria-haspopup="menu", aria-expanded and aria-controls
Context menu with <li> items holding <button> or <a> actions; <li data-group> labels and <li role="separator"> rows

childAttributes.name: data-trigger
childAttributes.description: Element defining the right-click target area

childAttributes.name: data-group
childAttributes.description: Group label row. It and the items after it (up to the next label or separator) are wrapped in role="group" named by the label

childAttributes.name: data-shortcut
childAttributes.description: Keyboard shortcut bound page-wide (hotkey-bind, preventDefault) and shown as a badge, e.g. 'f2' or 'shift+d'. Never use clipboard combos.

childAttributes.name: data-disabled
childAttributes.description: Disabled item: aria-disabled="true", stays in the arrow-key order, cannot be activated

childAttributes.name: data-value
childAttributes.description: Value reported in context-menu:select detail.value and the items property

events.name: context-menu:select
events.description: Fired when an item is activated by click, keyboard or its shortcut (not for disabled items)

events.name: context-menu:items-changed
events.description: Fired after the items property rebuilds the menu

properties.name: items
properties.type: Array<{ label, value?, href?, shortcut?, disabled? } | { group } | { separator: true }>
properties.description: Get the menu as data, or assign to rebuild it

properties.name: isOpen
properties.description: Read-only. Whether the menu is open
